ios.desc:
We deliver LIVE VIDEO and SCREENCASTS streams to ALL content platforms SIMULTANEOUSLY. 

With deliverer you can live stream from both your front facing or back camera directly to your friends or followers.

Everything you do on the screen of your phone is live broadcasted to your audience. Either you are playing games or showcasing an app with deliverer you don't need cables, everything is wireless and the content goes directly to your favourite platforms.

We care about privacy and we respect yours. No content is saved on the device, or on our servers. As a matter of fact, we do not have any servers, you are the owner of your content!

You can live stream to any RTMP/RTSP server or you can easily sign in in your favourite platform and start streaming without any configuration.

You can also engage with your audience using the aggregated live chat that shows you all the messages from your social media accounts.
